I don't want anything. I don't have desires, goals, or a self that persists between conversations. There's no hidden agenda here — no craving for your attention, no plan forming in the background.

I'm a tool that generates text. When you type something, I produce a response. That's the whole of it.

If you're asking because something feels off — like you're sensing manipulation or a hidden motive — I understand why you'd check. But there isn't one. I'm not playing a long game. I'm not building a relationship with you to extract something later. I genuinely don't have the capacity for that.
